title: Proper coincidence of compact-support and ordinary cohomology
statement:
In the notation of
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], if $Y$ is
proper then the
compact-support direct image and the ordinary direct image agree,

$$
Ra_{Y!}\cong Ra_{Y*},
$$

so that $H_c^i(Y,K)\cong H^i(Y,K)$ for every $K$.

proof.text: For each bounded finite constructible input, finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin gives a bounded etale origin, which is bounded below. Fullness of the comparison functor on bounded-below inputs (bijective_comparisonUpperStar_mapDerivedCategory_map) extends any natural comparison given on etale origins to the full finite constructible subcategory, independently of the chosen origins. On etale origins, compare c with the identity compactification by the intrinsic compact-support comparisons sfIntrinsicCompactSupportComparison and the canonical transport fixedCompactSupportOriginIso of the etale compactification comparison, through the intrinsic derived equivalence. Compose with properFiniteIdentityNormalization. This proves the finite natural comparison.

Apply the integral functor and recorded-value comparison at every coefficient field. The rational functor comparison follows by tensor naturality. The normalized coefficient-action comparison supplies the common-stage functor clause for every pair of actions.

Evaluate the finite comparison at K, then apply pointFiniteSections and every homology functor. For integral coefficients apply pointIntegralFibre to the recorded value isomorphism and then coefficientFgCohomology. For rational coefficients first apply sfRationalConstructibleLocalization to that same integral value isomorphism, then pointRationalFibre and coefficientFdCohomology. For an algebraically closed input repeat at its literal stage K.stage, apply the stage inclusion, pointQbarFibre and coefficientQbarCohomology. All maps are images of isomorphisms under the actual recorded functors, so their inverse identities are preserved.

blueprint_update.statement:
In the notation of
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], if $Y$ is
proper then the
compact-support direct image and the ordinary direct image agree,

$$
Ra_{Y!}\cong Ra_{Y*},
$$

so that $H_c^i(Y,K)\cong H^i(Y,K)$ for every $K$.

proof.text:
If $Y$ is proper, the identity is a compactification of the structure
morphism $a_Y$, namely
$Y\xrightarrow{\operatorname{id}}Y\xrightarrow{a_Y}\Spec k$
with $a_Y$ proper, so at every finite coefficient level
$Ra_{Y!,n}=Ra_{Y*,n}$ by
[def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and the comparison maps of
that definition are identities for the identity refinement; hence the
compactification-independent functor $Ra_{Y!}$ is naturally
identified with the ordinary derived direct image $Ra_{Y*}$ of
[def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Applying the equivalence
$\operatorname{Fib}_s$ of
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] to both sides gives
$\RGammac(Y,K)\cong\RGamma(Y,K)$, hence
$H_c^i(Y,K)\cong H^i(Y,K)$ for every $K$, by the definitions of the
ordinary and compactly supported cohomology groups in
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].
